Impressive food
Feb 2023 • Solo
I had a taste for sushi, I saw the ratings and went to it. I was very pleased with the size of the rolls. The food was excellent. Had some edemame and 2 rolls, including a small bottle of sake. 
The manager Hiromasa )Hiro) talked to me for a while. A very funny guy. I was so impress by the restaurant staff that I ate there for the 3 days in Quy Nhon. One of the girls turned me on to a different roll which I found delightful. I did not stay as long as I would have wanted. 
I will return and will go back to eat at Sho.
Thank you to the staff for their knowledge, professionalism and attitude. You have a returning customer.

Simply incredible
Feb 2021 • Couples
We were so surprised when we found this authentic Japanese restaurant in Quy Nhon, we were even happier that we got the chance to try it. The food was absolutely incredible, we tried a few sushi dishes and also tried some dumplings too. We forgot to take photos unfortunately as they were all beautiful dishes. We also met the Owner/Manager and he is truly a great guy. We were sad that we only got the chance to visit one time as I would have definitely liked to visit one more time on my holiday. I highly recommend. The sushi was so fresh and tasty. All the staff there were super friendly despite the obvious language barrier. Excellent restaurant!! Probably the best sushi we have ever had in Vietnam.
